name: Walking the Way All Alone
overview: Luo Li was born and raised in the spiritless land of the Silver Continent, where he rose to become the top assassin of the Tianjue Killing Hall. At the cost of his own life, his father, Master Ciyun, secures a slim chance of survival for him—allowing Luo Li to escape Silver Continent and set out for the Central World. There, he will seek the true path of cultivation… and the destiny that awaits him.[大道独行之蝶龙变-Bstation]
